decisions.reason: Because it is close to the core pipeline business, uses existing capabilities, and was publicly promoted, management is inclined to justify the earlier launch and treat any weak demand as temporary.
As a single waste-bin product far from the firm's core offer, it is easier to abandon despite some website commitment because it is less central to the firm's announced direction.
This waste-bin-with-ashtray line is distant from the core but the several-model range and public launch create enough sunk commitment that management is likely to persist a bit longer.
Although publicly launched as a line, standalone outdoor ashtrays are a niche and peripheral extension, so the pressure to justify the earlier decision is weaker than for products closer to the core.
